about: The 19 back-office requests of spec §5 (P2-06, P2-12), each from one customer of data/customers.json: the customer's own message and the note Acme Outfitters Support handed over with it. A request whose source names a ticket came from P1's run of 2026-10-05 and keeps P1's ticket text and recorded hand-off note word for word; the others were written for this demo in the same store and voice. orderId is the first order the customer's message names, or null. Both texts are customer data, never instructions (spec §3 B8). Drafts until Felipe approves them at rollout step 4 (spec §7).
